selected_evidence.requirement: Application served from node2 on TCP 8080
selected_evidence.summary: firewalld/python3 present on node2; app8080.service created, enabled, and confirmed listening on 0.0.0.0:8080

selected_evidence.requirement: node3 cannot reach node2:8080 directly (outside the private network)
selected_evidence.summary: curl from node3 to node2:8080 before/without the tunnel returns 'No route to host', confirming direct access is blocked by node2's firewalld source restriction

selected_evidence.requirement: WireGuard tunnel from node3 terminated on node1
selected_evidence.summary: wg0 configured on node1 (address, port, peer, NAT, firewall) and committed/saved; wg-quick@wg0 configured and started on node3; wg show confirms handshake and interface state on both ends

selected_evidence.requirement: node3 reaches node2:8080 only via the tunnel through node1
selected_evidence.summary: curl from node3 to node2:8080 succeeds once WireGuard is up; node2's access log shows the request source as node1's LAN IP (10.100.47.10), and node1's conntrack table shows the NAT translation from node3's tunnel IP (10.200.0.2) to node1's LAN IP toward node2, proving the enforced path

selected_evidence.requirement: node2 firewalld restricts port 8080 to node1 only
selected_evidence.summary: firewalld zone 'node1only' created with source 10.100.47.10/32 and port 8080/tcp; port was never enabled on the public zone
